properties.title: M5.3 Earthquake - Dunhuang, China
properties.description: M5.3 earthquake 265 km SSE of Dunhuang, China. USGS ShakeMap MMI 6.5 (yellow alert). 81 stations reported. Reviewed status.

properties.title: Typhoon NINE-26 - Guam / CNMI
properties.description: Typhoon NINE-26 approaching Guam and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands. Maximum sustained winds 213 km/h. Orange alert; 59,760 people in affected zone.

properties.title: M7.5 Earthquake - Venezuela
properties.description: Magnitude 7.5 earthquake struck Venezuela; at least 1,943 deaths confirmed as of July 1. Major infrastructure damage in Caracas and coastal states.

properties.title: RSF Drone Strikes - El Obeid, Sudan
properties.description: RSF drone strikes on El Obeid (North Kordofan) and Kassala, targeting SAF logistics routes. Consistent with RSF operational pattern of disabling SAF supply chains ahead of offensive pushes.

properties.title: JNIM Attack - Niamey Airport, Niger
properties.description: JNIM complex attack on Niamey Diori Hamani International Airport (June 18). First successful JNIM strike on a capital-city airport. Seven Chinese nationals reported kidnapped in northern Mali, signals JNIM shifting to high-value hostage operations.

properties.title: IDF Strike - al-Baqa Cafe, Beit Lahiya, Gaza
properties.description: IDF strike on al-Baqa cafe in Beit Lahiya, northern Gaza Strip (June 30). Reported mass casualty event. Al-Qassam Brigades launched rocket barrage in response. Ceasefire negotiations stalled in Doha.

properties.title: Ukrainian Strike - Penza, Russia
properties.description: Ukrainian long-range drone and missile strike on Penza defense industrial complex (July 1). Secondary explosions reported at munitions storage. Gripen-E air defense intercept documented near Odessa the same morning.

properties.title: State of Emergency - Crimea
properties.description: Russian-administered Crimea declared a state of emergency following Ukrainian drone strikes on Sevastopol naval infrastructure. Civilian evacuation orders issued for port districts.

properties.title: Iran-US Nuclear MOU - Islamabad
properties.description: Iran and US initialed a preliminary memorandum of understanding in Islamabad (June 29) capping Iranian uranium enrichment at 20 percent and allowing IAEA snapback monitoring. 72-hour window for Iran's Supreme National Security Council ratification. Polymarket: 28% probability of withdrawal by July 7.

properties.title: SCOTUS - Birthright Citizenship Ruling
properties.description: US Supreme Court upheld 5-4 the executive order restricting birthright citizenship for children of undocumented immigrants. Justice Barrett joined the majority. Immediate injunctions sought in 14 states. APA challenge pathway remains open per majority opinion.
